text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the 
Twinkle Series, Mejiro Palmer defied all 
common sense with her wild success—

"And in recognition of that achievement, a 
truly 'out-of-this-world gift' was 
bestowed upon her."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Commendation! Trainer, in honor of Mejiro 
Palmer's numerous achievements—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A supplementary prize! There's a gift from 
a corporation supporting the Twinkle 
Series.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Take full responsibility and deliver it 
straight to Mejiro Palmer!

A mission entrusted to me by Chairwoman 
Akikawa. The problem is, how should I 
deliver it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh crap! I'm late, I'm late~! Being late 
on a day like this is totally out of the 
question!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Where's Trainer? Given what happened, 
they're probably mad... Where are they? 
Where, where, where?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Not here? Don't tell me Trainer is 
late too~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, there's no way. Did something happen 
along the way...?
(Honk honk!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Eep! Ah, I'm sorry! I'll move right a—... 
Wait... huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!?
(Vroom, purrrrr...)

I decided to keep driving along the bay, 
letting Mejiro Palmer simply enjoy the 
ride.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer, nice, nice! More, more! Hyahoo☆

Frolicking excitedly while feeling the 
wind, and then—
(Whooosh, whooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Phew, we've driven pretty far. You know, 
there's something really nice about 
driving with no destination in mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's so true! Running away, 
running away, running like crazy from my 
tiny self and the path laid out for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've finally made it this far and gained 
confidence. And thanks to that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, the wind feels so nice. I'm not 
afraid of anything anymore!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Well, until I met you, Trainer, I spent 
too much time hesitating at the start and 
fell way behind."
choice_data_list:
Still, you managed to catch up with your 
second burst of speed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: “Yeah. A youth one lap behind. But...”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing that can't be reclaimed! 
Even the things I don't have right now, 
I'll get my hands on them someday!

Something she doesn't have yet. If I'm 
going to give her one of those, now might 
be the time.
choice_data_list:
By the way, there's something I want to 
give you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Something to give me? What is it? Is it 
something that'll totally hype me up, 
maybe?

I turn my gaze toward the car parked on 
the road. The car the two of us rode here 
in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You mean that... rental car we came in? 
Does that mean you're letting me drive on 
the way back?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh, no way!? Trainer, what do you mean?

I explain. That this is a commemorative 
car specially presented by a company that 
supports the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A commemorative car... Then that really is 
my car...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I can do whatever I want with it? No 
matter how I use it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: W-W-Wait...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! That is totally the best!!!! We can 
go anywhere we want, whenever we want.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"That means we get to go for as many 
drives as we want, right, Trainer?!"

While nodding, something still bothered 
you. And that was...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah. After all, it's not something I 
grabbed on my own, so I wanna share it 
properly, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, and one more thing, Trainer. If you 
don't mind, could you give this car a 
name?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I wanna cherish riding it for a long, 
long time, so pick a name I won't get 
tired of, okay? A name that feels worth 
taking care of.

A reward for my achievements. And a name I 
can cherish. If so, this is the only thing 
that comes to mind.
choice_data_list: Then I'll go with Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's mine...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... I can cherish it 
forever?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it's also a commemoration of 
achievements.

Yeah, it's also in commemoration of their 
achievements.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I see. Let's go with that, then. 
You're right, simple is best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the Mejiro Palmer! There really 
isn't anything out of reach!

Mejiro Palmer nods with satisfaction. Not 
a single cloud hangs over her smile.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A car... Yeah. Maybe so. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And a whole bunch of other things, too. 
Now then, let's get back to our drive!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Trainer, hurry!

Though Mejiro Palmer arrived late, she 
surged ahead in an instant, forcefully 
pulling the pack—
(VRRROOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Push it faster, even faster, Trainer! 
Right to the absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
FuFu~! Freedom is the absolute best! Run, 
run, Mejiro Palmer Express!
(VRRRRRRROOOOOOOM!!!!!)

"Accelerating even further is Mejiro 
Palmer. Once an unknown latecomer 
front-runner, but now—"
(WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

Running out in front, ahead of everyone 
else.

“Yes, leading an unorthodox royal road. 
Tracing a path more free than any Mejiro 
before her.”
